# CommunityStructureInference

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The process of partitioning a network into densely connected subgroups (communities) using probabilistic models that account for edge uncertainty. Critical for optimizing data flow and reducing communication overhead in topology-centric computing systems by identifying modular clusters.
